project_type: Flutter mobile application with provider state management
build_system: Flutter SDK with pub dependency manager
build_command: flutter build apk or flutter build ios (platform-specific)
verification_instructions: Run 'flutter analyze' to check for errors, 'flutter test' for unit tests if written, and 'flutter run' on emulator/device to verify UI behavior. Check no compilation errors and app launches successfully.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that need to be checked in. Build artifacts go to build/ which is gitignored.
environment_constraints: Flutter app requires Flutter SDK installed. No live databases - all data must be in-memory only. Firebase imports are commented out in main.dart and should remain so.
contribution_requirements: Use existing theme from lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart with AppConstants.ugandaGreen (0xFF08A71D primary, 0xFF09420E dark). Match existing design patterns from home_screen.dart (cards with borderRadius 20-28, Color(0xFFF5F5F3) background, Color(0xFF111111) text, Color(0xFF777777) muted). Use provider for state management as already set up in main.dart.
key_patterns: Screens use Card widgets with elevation 0, borderRadius 20-28. AppBar uses white background with dark green foreground. Bottom navigation pattern in home_screen.dart has 5 items. Forms use TextFormField with validators. Currency format uses AppConstants.defaultCurrency (UGX). Date formatting uses intl package DateFormat. Charts use fl_chart package (BarChart, PieChart examples in reports_screen.dart).
directory_structure: lib/data/ (models, repositories), lib/services/ (business logic), lib/providers/ (state management), lib/screens/ (UI organized by feature), lib/widgets/ (reusable components), lib/utils/ (formatters, validators, helpers), lib/core/ (theme, routes, constants)
